steps.name: Check source and dependency locks were not modified
Check both source formats without rewriting the candidate
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
import subprocess
paths = ['internal/poolbridge', 'integration/cometbft/poolapp',
         'integration/cometbft/labnet', 'integration/cometbft/cmd/zevune-network']
result = subprocess.run(['gofmt', '-l', *paths], check=True,
                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
go_diff_code = 0
if result.stdout.strip():
    go_diff_code = subprocess.run(['gofmt', '-d', *paths]).returncode
rust = subprocess.run(['cargo', '+1.98.1', 'fmt', '--manifest-path',
                       'integration/orchard/Cargo.toml', '--all', '--', '--check'])
raise SystemExit(bool(result.stdout.strip()) or go_diff_code != 0 or rust.returncode != 0)
PY
